summary: Korro Bio filed an 8-K disclosing receipt on November 3, 2026 of Novo Nordisk's written notice terminating for convenience the September 13, 2024 research collaboration and license agreement, as amended November 11, 2025. Termination is effective February 1, 2027 after the contractual 90-day notice. Korro had received a $10.0 million upfront payment plus R&D cost reimbursement; no milestones were earned. Novo Nordisk never nominated a second target and did not exercise substitution rights during the 12-month hold. Post-termination, licenses revert, IP ownership is retained by each party, and Novo reimburses wind-down costs. Watch for pipeline/runway implications and any re-partnering or strategic review signals.
